notes: Trade is steel products, gross weight: HS 72 (iron and steel) without pig iron, ferro-alloys and scrap (HS 7201 to 7205). Tubes, pipes and hollow profiles (HS 7304 to 7306, chapter 73) are not included: all countries exported 35.8 Mt of them in 2024, 10.1 Mt by China (see the table of tube exporters). The world total adds up the exports of every country, so it includes trade between EU member states. USGS production is raw steel.
USGS lists 11 producing countries; Italy, Taiwan, Mexico, Indonesia, Canada, France and Spain, among others, are in its 'Other countries' line.
discrepancies: Crude steel production 2025: the USGS estimate is 1,823 Mt for the listed countries and 'Other countries' (USGS rounds its world total to 1,900 Mt); the World Steel Association reports 1,849.4 Mt of world crude steel production for 2025 (press release of 23 January 2026, https://worldsteel.org/media/press-releases/2026/december-2025-crude-steel-production-2025-global-crude-steel-production/). The table shows the USGS figures, which come by country; the World Steel Association's own tables are not copied.
